rules: Official primary sources only, read on the source page; sums checked to the cent with a planted-error control (pipelines/complete_totals/).

ponte_supervision_2006_2010.what_it_measures: Amount paid (gross, payment date in 2006 to 2010) on supervision contract PJ-170/2006, Consórcio Prosul-Concremat: Prosul R$ 5.389.722,50 and Concremat R$ 3.592.718,61
ponte_supervision_2006_2010.source_doc: Alesc, CPI da Ponte Hercílio Luz (RQC/0016.6/2019), relatório final do relator, Apêndice A 'Atualização dos valores contratuais', tables 'Contrato PJ 170/2006 - Prosul' (pp. 1754 to 1763) and 'Contrato PJ 170/2006 - Concremat' (pp. 1763 to 1773); document of 19/12/2019; the winning vote (anexo 10772) adopts the rapporteur's report changing only pp. 1718 and 1719
ponte_supervision_2006_2010.source_quote: Columns 'DATA DO PAGAMENTO' and 'VALOR DO PAGAMENTO'; 'TOTAL 9.160.234,16' (Prosul) and 'TOTAL 6.106.108,71' (Concremat)
ponte_supervision_2006_2010.how_checked: ponte_supervision_cpi.py: parsed payments == printed TOTAL and == sum of 'PGTOS NO MÊS' column, to the cent, per contract; 2011-2013 equal to the SC Portal SICOP vlpago of both lines to the cent (2011 split differs by R$ 110.869,79 between the two lines, explained: the extract books a Prosul payment under the Concremat line); 2014 Concremat equal to the Portal creditor view (R$ 479.649,53); --control (+R$ 0,01) fails
ponte_supervision_2006_2010.tce_sc_19_4_note: TCE-SC news of 19/10/2015 says R$ 19,4 milhões were paid to the supervision consortium; that equals the contract value with the 2010 and 2012 amendments (R$ 19.436.343,14), not the payments (R$ 15.266.342,87 in total). Not used.

ponte_total_13_contracts.what_it_measures: Total paid (nominal, gross of withheld taxes) on the restoration of the Ponte Hercílio Luz, 2006 to 2020, read contract by contract: the 12 contracts of the SIGEF register (13 records; PJ-170/2006 has one line per consortium member) and the first stage, PJ 015/2006 (Consórcio Roca-TEC), from the ALESC CPI final report
ponte_total_13_contracts.added_detail: First stage PJ 015/2006 (Consórcio Roca-TEC, payments 2006-06-27 to 2009-09-18), CPI Apêndice A payment tables: TEC R$ 11.957.532,70 and Roca R$ 11.957.530,83 (audit of 2026-10-06, cases, A1)
ponte_total_13_contracts.pj264_pre_2011_note: Now printed payment by payment in the CPI table (p. 1773), equal to the cent to the difference TCE-SC minus Portal used on 2026-10-05
ponte_total_13_contracts.source_quote: CPI Apêndice A totals: PJ 170/2006 Prosul 9.160.234,16; Concremat 6.106.108,71; PJ 264/2008 63008872,09; the other ten contracts from data/hercilio-luz-paid-by-contract.json (Portal SICOP extracts); PJ 015/2006 TEC 11.957.532,70 (VALOR TOTAL) and Roca 11.957.530,83 (TOTAL), Apêndice A
ponte_total_13_contracts.how_checked: build_paid_by_contract.py: pass 1 Decimal contract by contract (Portal payment lines, CPI payment lines, PJ 015/2006 VALOR MEDIDO column), pass 2 integer cents (Portal vlpago grand total with the three pre-2011 contracts swapped for the CPI PGTOS NO MÊS columns, plus the same column of PJ 015/2006); equal to the cent; every CPI table equals its own TOTAL line; --control fails.
not_included: DL-00001/2618-2019 (RMG, R$ 1.451.313,01 pagos em 2019, supervisão fora do escopo do PJ-00093/2016): registro à parte (related_records), fora desta soma até decisão do autor.
Pagamentos que não estão ligados ao contrato no extrato (PJ-00060/2019, R$ 16.002,61) e obras da ponte antes de 2006 ou depois de 2019: fora do escopo.

ete_insular.value_precision: R$ milhões (the source publishes no cents)
ete_insular.what_it_measures: Investimento total realizado (resources applied, Casan's recorded cost of the work, may include capitalized borrowing costs) in 'Ampliação do Sistema de Esgotamento Sanitário Insular', from the start to 31/12/2025; R$ 27 milhões of it in 2025
ete_insular.source_doc: Casan, Relatório da Administração 2025, Tabela 9, p. 25 of the PDF (same table in the DFP 2025, https://ri.casan.com.br/bfd_download/dfp-2025/)
ete_insular.source_quote: Florianópolis | Esgoto | Ampliação do Sistema de Esgotamento Sanitário Insular | 27 | 229 (Investimento em 2025; Investimento total realizado, R$ milhões); 'Principais investimentos no ano (em termos de recursos aplicados)'
ete_insular.how_checked: Read in the PDF text layer of both the management report and the DFP 2025. No official paid-to-date figure for 2026 exists.

consumed_definition.finding: Casan does not define 'Consumido' anywhere in its portal; the contract extract shows Original, Consumido and Saldo = valorContrato - valorConsumido, source SAP, data manager Gerência de Licitações (GLI). It is not published as 'pago'. It does not track billing: +R$ 26.059.813,80 from 2026-09-05 to 2026-10-06 while principal billed rose R$ 1.359.127,94.

details.principal_note: Now EOC 1246/2020 principal (197.768.490,12) + EOC 1534/2026 (31.190.417,28), equal to the cent; billed is without readjustments

sc401_paid.what_it_measures: Gross amount paid on the works contract CT-00014/2025 (vlpago): net transfer to the contractor (R$ 39.600.403,49) plus taxes withheld and paid on its behalf, INSS, IRRF and ISS (R$ 2.094.311,74); equal to the cent to the accumulated measured value of 18 measurements up to 2026-08-31 (R$ 40.224.998,39 at initial prices + R$ 1.469.716,84 readjustment)
sc401_paid.previous_value_note: Same definition, Portal load of 2026-09-30; R$ 965.949,23 liquidated in 2026 was paid on 2026-09-30
sc401_paid.source_quote: contratoResumoFinanceiro: 2025 vlpago 26786756.45; 2026 vlpago 14907958.78. Glossary 'Valor Pago': 'Após a conferência do recebimento de bens, materiais e serviços (liquidação), a despesa foi devidamente paga.' 'Retenção': 'É o valor retido pelo Estado do montante a ser pago ao credor. Esse valor é repassado para a pessoa de direito.'
sc401_paid.how_checked: sicop_paid.py 104411: per year, sum of payment lines == vlpago to the cent; net + withheld == paid; paid == last accumulated measurement; --control (+R$ 0,01 on one line) fails

related_not_summed.note: Supervision object covers restoration of SC-401 and SC-404 in three stretches, so it is not added (D95). Works + project = R$ 42.135.822,41.
